t: Sanding block that can last up to 5x longer than sanding paper. A strong surface structure combines advanced bonding and surface coating techniques to fix the grains to the backing. Block does not lose grit when sanding around edges and corners. Minimises clogging while dust can easily be knocked or washed off the flexible surface. Also shapes to surfaces with even pressure. Suitable for a variety of applications.
b: Suitable for Sanding Wood & Paint on Wood
L x W x T: 97 x 67 x 26mm
